metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Chrome with docs.python.org as one of two tabs. Demonstrated Chrome navigation and settings interaction.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome to docs.python.org and interact with Chrome settings. Steps 38-43 showed Python docs tab opened successfully.
metadata.explanation: Compound check: 0.5 for docs.python.org open as active tab + 0.5 for Chrome default font size set to Large (value=20). Custom getter reads Chrome Preferences file for font size and accessibility tree for active URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads default_font_size from Chrome Preferences file (webkit.webprefs.default_font_size), which is the persistent storage for Chrome font settings.
Getter extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree using a pattern targeting the address bar, with a fallback regex for any https URL.

Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': directly accesses expected.get('expected_url') and expected.get('expected_font_size') without the incorrect expected.get('rules') anti-pattern.
Expected values are semantically correct: 'docs.python.org' for Python documentation and 20 for Chrome Large font size.
Both task requirements (Python docs open as active tab + default font size set to Large) are covered with partial credit (0.5 each), totaling 1.0.
No postconfig needed: font size persists in Preferences file and is readable without reopening UI; accessibility tree reflects live tab URL.
